svg.title: Mochaa — the Bug Slayer
svg.desc: A Frieren-themed title card for Mochaa (naichii, 1naichii), a versatile software engineer. Behind the title is the official art board of the ruined church in a flower field from the Episode 2 flashback (painted by Studio Wyeth, ©K.Y.T.A/S/FP), with soft sunbeams and petals lifting off the field.
